entities.summary: Renato Corsetti was an Italian Esperantist who served as President of the Universal Esperanto Association from 2001 to 2007. Born in Rome, Corsetti supported the idea that the people of the world should be able to communicate in a neutral and easy international language. He taught psycholinguistics at the Sapienza University of Rome. He was also an associate professor at the International Academy of Sciences San Marino.
